reason: I run three agents a day and my team won't standardize on one, so a shared layer between agents doesn't solve anything I can actually use — I won't add a local daemon to maintain for a workflow my team won't align on.
objection: My team uses different agents; I can't force them all onto one, so the shared-context promise doesn't land for us.
would_change_my_mind: If my team standardized on one agent and the daemon proved it never sees or stores our credentials.
